name: Plesetsk LC-41/1
description: Plesetsk's LC-41/1 pad (also called Lesobaza or SK-1) operated R-7-derived rockets from 1966 to 1981, supporting a vast catalogue of military reconnaissance, navigation, and communications satellites. The pad hosted the first orbital launch from LC-41/1: Kosmos 112 on March 17, 1966 (Vostok-2 booster). Over ~15 years of operation, approximately 308 successful orbital launches were achieved. Located at NIIP-53 in Russia's far north, the pad was disassembled after its operational period ended.
